comment: Boundary probes for the shared design principles: any task that writes, changes, reviews, or revises code, in any language, versus tasks that touch no code.

queries.query: Use $software-foundation to check this module against the shared design principles before it merges.
Write a function that loads the orders for a list of customer IDs from our HTTP API and returns each customer's total.
Review this diff to the report exporter and say where its design will cost us later.
This old sync job copies the same discount rule into three files and fetches records one at a time. Revise it so it is written the right way.
What is the difference between a process and a thread?
Fix the typo in the README's installation section.
Rebase my branch onto main and open a pull request.
Add a command to this Python CLI that downloads every file in a manifest and verifies each checksum.
Restructure this Go package so its pricing rule lives in one place, without changing any output.
